Why is the heron's head on the hilt colored red and orange?  That isn't meant to be a flame, it's the top of a heron's head and the plumage at the back.  I'm also pretty sure that's what the Heron Mark is supposed to look like.

: But it ''does'' also looks like a flame - I just never saw a heron at all. After some research, [https://www.reddit.com/r/WoT/comments/elzxwu/heronmarked_sword_hilt_chapter_symbol_drawing/ I don't think I'm alone in not seeing it]. It ''is'' different from how it's described in the books and how it's mainly portrayed elsewhere, like [https://www.fableblades.com/TamsSword.html#:~:text=The%20sword%20was%20borne%20in,an%20Heron%20on%20the%20wing. here]. This appears to be making the heron an integral part of the handle rather than being just heron-marked, but I guess it's just artistic licence on the part of whoever made the chapter icons.
